summary: Greenfield public API (keys, quotas, 4 endpoints, webhooks, gate, OpenAPI, docs) is ~40 files / >1500 lines; split into 4 sub-issues.

subissues.title: feat(api): API keys, scopes, quotas, usage billing and rate limits for the public API (#487 part 1)
subissues.body: Part of #487. Add per-workspace API keys (hashed at rest, shown once), scopes, per-key quotas and rate limits, a usage key for billed calls via the #30 usage service, and a BearerResolver (apps/api/src/middleware/auth.ts) that resolves keys to a principal. Register in cross-tenant, core-domains and db test lists. Acceptance: keys, scopes and quotas are enforced and usage is billed per call [integration].

subissues.title: feat(api): public v1 read endpoints with provenance and data-class gate (#487 part 2)
subissues.body: Part of #487. Under apps/api/src/public/v1/: GET /v1/cases/{cnr}, /v1/causelists, /v1/orders, /v1/notices. Every record carries provenance and source_license; serve only cleared sources or contributed copies and only data_class non-personal via exposableThroughApi (packages/core/src/sources/registry.ts:25), personal data only for the caller's own matters, per docs/legal/court-data-posture.md. Acceptance: only cleared-source data with provenance on every record [integration].

subissues.title: feat(api): change webhooks for status, list and order changes (#487 part 3)
subissues.body: Part of #487. Webhook endpoints per workspace, signed delivery with retries, fired on status, cause-list and order changes for watched items; worker delivery job registered in apps/worker registry and schedules tests. Acceptance: webhooks fire on changes for watched items [integration].

subissues.title: docs(api): OpenAPI spec validation and developer docs at apps/site (#487 part 4)
subissues.body: Part of #487. Regenerate apps/api/openapi/v1.json for the public routes, validate it with swagger-parser, and publish developer docs in apps/site. Acceptance: the OpenAPI spec passes validation [unit].
